Return the frozen color relevance scale times the inferred carrier difference. Score centered R2 and its paired difference against the same inferred identities with the single mean scale.
secondary: Repeat query decoding at clean blocks 23, 27 and 31 with unchanged source decoder. Report identity-pair recovery, clean-answer identification, relevance accuracy, oracle R2 with annotated identities and relation, and exact clean first-token accuracy.
